sections.title: How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank

location.heading: How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank

blocks.text: If your employment has changed, or your salary account is no longer receiving regular salary credits, you may need to convert your Salary Account to a regular Savings Account. At ZX Bank, this process is straightforward. Here’s how you can do it:

location.heading: How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank
Why Convert Your Salary Account?

items.text: Salary accounts are typically provided to employees for salary credits and have special benefits.
If salary credits stop (for 3+ months), your account may be automatically converted to a Savings Account by the bank, but manual conversion avoids service interruptions.
Savings accounts have different features and requirements, including minimum balance criteria.

sections.title: Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account

location.heading: How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank
Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account
1. Visit Your Home Branch

items.text: Locate your nearest ZX Bank branch (especially the one where you opened your salary account).
Carry valid proof of identity (Aadhaar, PAN Card, Passport, etc.) and account passbook/debit card.

sections.title: 2. Fill Out the Account Conversion Request Form

location.heading: Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account
2. Fill Out the Account Conversion Request Form

items.text: Request a Salary to Savings Account Conversion Form at the branch.
Fill in your details, mention your account number, and select “Convert to Savings Account.”
Attach self-attested copies of requested KYC documents (if required).

location.heading: Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account
3. Submit the Form and Documents

items.text: Hand over the filled form and documents to the branch staff.
The staff will verify your documents and initiate the conversion process.

location.heading: Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account
4. Maintain Minimum Balance

items.text: Ensure you maintain the required minimum balance for Savings Accounts as per ZX Bank guidelines, to avoid charges.

location.heading: Steps to Convert Salary Account to Savings Account
5. Get Confirmation

items.text: You will receive confirmation via SMS/email once the conversion is complete.
Existing debit card, chequebook, and account number typically remain unchanged.

location.heading: How to Convert Your Salary Account to a Savings Account at ZX Bank
Alternative: Conversion via Digital Banking

blocks.text: ZX Bank also enables digital requests:

location.heading: Alternative: Conversion via Digital Banking

items.text: Open the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App or log into NetBanking.
Go to “Service Requests” > “Convert Salary Account to Savings Account.”
Fill in details and upload necessary KYC docs, if asked.
Receive confirmation after processing.
